eng-program.program:
(define (plain x) (clamp x 0 10))
(define (physical pixels) (clamp pixels 0 320))
(define (health health) (clamp health 0 100))
(display (list (plain 15) (physical 330) (health 105)))
(newline)

(display (list (plain -5) (physical 330) (health 105)))
(newline)

eng-program.program:
(define (holds? x lo hi)
  (lambda (x lo hi) (and (<= lo hi) (<= (clamp x lo hi) hi))))
(display (map (lambda (c) (apply holds? c)) (list (list 5 1 2) (list 0 1 2) (list 3 1 2) (list 1 1 2) (list 2 1 2))))
(newline)
